title: Phishing Campaign Targeting HR Department
root_cause: Root cause traced to: Phishing email with spoofed IT helpdesk sender delivered to 3 HR mailboxes (ATT&CK stage: Initial Access).

timeline.description: Phishing email with spoofed IT helpdesk sender delivered to 3 HR mailboxes
Two recipients clicked the embedded credential-harvesting link
Successful login using harvested credentials from a new device

recommended_action: Review and strengthen perimeter controls such as email filtering and MFA.
executive_summary: A phishing campaign successfully reached 3 organizational assets, leading to Initial Access. A review of perimeter and email security controls is recommended.
